
## Cox: Fine Gray

Fine Gray model using death as competing risk

**Create variables**
  
  ```{r}

df.fg.tmp <- NULL
df.tdc.fg <- NULL

df.tdc.fg.l <- lapply(names_ep, as.null) %>% setNames(names_ep) 
for(ep in unlist(names_ep)){
  
  #ep <- "DEMENTIA"
  ep_age_tmp <- as.character(str_glue("{ep}_AGE"))
  
  df.fg.tmp <-   df %>%
    mutate(EVENT_DEATH2 = if_else(get(ep) == 1, get(ep), as.integer(DEATH*2))) %>%
    mutate(EVENT_DEATH2_AGE = if_else(get(ep) == 1, get(ep_age_tmp), DEATH_AGE)) %>%
    mutate(EVENT_DEATH2 = as.factor(EVENT_DEATH2)) %>%
    mutate(EVENT_DEATH2 = recode(EVENT_DEATH2, `0`="censor", `1`="event", `2`="death")) %>%  #select(EVENT_DEATH2) %>% summary()
    as_tibble() 
  
  df.tdc.fg      <- tmerge(data1=df.fg.tmp, data2=df.fg.tmp, id=FINNGENID, tstart = START_AGE, tstop = EVENT_DEATH2_AGE)
  
  for(var in tdc_vars_ever){
    #var %>% print()
    df.tdc.fg  <- tmerge(data1=df.tdc.fg, data2=df.fg.tmp, id=FINNGENID, tdc_var = tdc(get(str_glue("{var}_AGE"))), 
                         EVENT_DEATH2 = event(EVENT_DEATH2_AGE, EVENT_DEATH2)) %>%
      rename(!!str_glue("{var}_TDC") := tdc_var)
  }
  
  df.tdc.fg.l[[ep]] <- df.tdc.fg %>%
    filter(tstop > tstart+0.003) %>%  #0.003 years = one day; coxph would inteprete very short time difference 0 time followup
    mutate(time_test = tstop - tstart)
  
}

# Number of individuals in each class
lapply(names_ep, function(ep){table(df.tdc.fg.l[[ep]]$EVENT_DEATH2)}) %>% setNames(names_ep) 

```

**Models**
  
  Surv(fgstart, fgstop, fgstatus) ~ {var} + WOMEN + BIRTH_YEAR + SMOKED + OBESITY_TDC + HYPLIP_WIDE_TDC + CHRONKIDNEYDIS_TDC + HYPERTENSION_TDC + DIABETES_TDC + AUD_TDC

```{r}


nicenames <- c(DEMENTIA = " Any dementia", ALZHEIMER = " Alzheimer disase", VASCDEM = " Vascular dementia", 
               AF_TDC = " Atrial fibrillation", OBESITY_TDC = " Obesity", 
               HYPLIP_WIDE_TDC = " Hyperlipidemia", HEARTFAIL_ALLCAUSE_TDC=" Heart failure", 
               MI_TDC = " Myocardial infarction", CHRONKIDNEYDIS_TDC = " Chronic kidney disease", 
               HYPERTENSION_TDC = " Hypertension", DIABETES_TDC = " Diabetes", STR_TDC = " Stroke",
               STR_EMBOLIC_TDC = " Embolic stroke", TIA_TDC = " TIA", 
               AUD_TDC = " Alcohol abuse", PAD_TDC = " PAD")

#Initialize
ep <-  "DEMENTIA"
cx.table.fg.l <- lapply(names_ep, function(x){NULL}) %>% setNames(unlist(names_ep))
#cx.table.fg.l.d  <- lapply(names_ep, function(x){NULL}) %>% setNames(unlist(names_ep))
cx.full.fg.l  <- lapply(names_ep, function(x){NULL}) %>% setNames(unlist(names_ep))

#For each outcome...
for(ep in unlist(names_ep)){
  
  #Covariate vector to formula format  
  oth_covs2_f <- paste(c(oth_covs2), collapse = " + ")
  #print(ep)
  
  fg.event.tdc <- finegray(Surv(tstart, tstop, EVENT_DEATH2) ~ ., data=df.tdc.fg.l[[ep]], etype="event", id=id)
  #fg.death.tdc <- finegray(Surv(tstart, tstop, EVENT_DEATH2) ~ ., data=df.tdc.fg.l[[ep]], etype="death",  id=id)
  
  #Models/dementia
  cx.l.tdc.fg<-
    lapply(as.list(tdc_vars2), function(var){
      
      my_formula <- str_glue("Surv(fgstart, fgstop, fgstatus) ~ {var} + {oth_covs2_f}")
      coxph(as.formula(my_formula), data=fg.event.tdc)
      
    }) %>% setNames(tdc_vars2)
  cx.full.fg.l[[ep]] <- cx.l.tdc.fg
  
  #Number of exposed
  nN <- fg.event.tdc %>%
    extract_nN_tdc(ep, tdc_vars2) 
  
  #Table
  cx.table.fg.l[[ep]]<- lapply(tdc_vars2, function(var){
    coefs <- cx.l.tdc.fg[[var]] %>% 
      my_extr_coef(ep, var)
  }) %>% setNames(tdc_vars2) %>%
    reduce(bind_rows) %>% 
    mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(pval, method = "fdr", n = length(names_ep)*length(tdc_vars2))) %>%
    left_join(nN, by="names") %>%
    select(name, names, est, lower, upper, pval, p.adj, nN_exp, nN_nexp) %>%
    my_tidy_est2() %>%
    rename(outcome=name, variable=names, mean=est, FDR=p.adj) %>%
    mutate(variable=nicenames[variable]) 
}
```

**Forest plots**
  
  ```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=8, message=F, results=F}


#Stupid hack: forestplot, when grouped, allows only text lines for groups.
#Thus lines within group needs to be combined to same cell and divided by "\n"
tmp <- cx.table.fg.l %>%
  reduce(bind_rows) %>%
  select(variable, outcome, nN_exp, FDR, est_ci) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=outcome, values_from=c("est_ci", "FDR", "nN_exp")) %>%
  unite(est_ci, matches("est_ci"), sep="\n") %>%
  unite(FDR, matches("FDR"), sep="\n") %>%
  unite(nN_exp, matches("nN"), sep="\n")

cx.table.fg <-cx.table.fg.l %>%
  reduce(bind_rows) %>%
  select(outcome, variable, mean, lower, upper) %>%
  left_join(tmp, by="variable")

#Forestplot&Table
font.s <- 1.3
font.l <- 1.5
lwd.bar <- 3

forest.fg <- cx.table.fg %>%
  group_by(outcome) %>%
  forestplot(labeltext = c(variable, nN_exp, est_ci, FDR),
             legend = c("Any dementia", "Alzheimer's disease", "Vascular dementia"),
             legend_args = fpLegend(pos = list(x = .8, y = 0.79), 
                                    gp = gpar(col = "#CCCCCC")),
             fn.ci_norm = c(fpDrawNormalCI, fpDrawDiamondCI, fpDrawCircleCI),
             #boxsize = .1, # We set the box size to better visualize the type
             line.margin = .25, # We need to add this to avoid crowding
             graph.pos=3,
             xlog=T,
             shapes_gp = fpShapesGp(default = gpar(lwd = lwd.bar)),
             txt_gp = fpTxtGp(ticks = gpar(cex=font.s-.1), 
                              label=list(gpar(cex=font.l), gpar(cex=font.s), gpar(cex=font.s), gpar(cex=font.s)),
                              legend=gpar(cex=font.s), 
                              summary = gpar(cex=font.l))
  ) %>%
  fp_add_header(variable= " Variable\n", nN_exp="Exposed\nn/N", est_ci = "HR (95% CI)\n", FDR = "FDR\n") %>%
  fp_set_style(box = c("#00BA38", "#619CFF", "#F8766D"),
               line = c("#00BA38", "#619CFF", "#F8766D"))  %>%
  fp_set_zebra_style("#EFEFEF")

png(str_glue("{fig_path}/forest.fg.png"), width = 1050, height = 700)
forest.fg
dev.off()

pdf(str_glue("{fig_path}/forest.fg.pdf"), width = 14.7, height = 9.8)
forest.fg
dev.off()
```
